## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the confined observer apparatus — an independently
   surviving supervisor, a durable marker sink (one fixed
   non-idempotent append of a unique trial/effect marker, flush +
   digest), a denied/read-only sentinel — plus the declared Kp4
   commit→injected-termination-before-executor-entry injection; the
   O8 seeded-duplicate detector (3/3 detected, labelled defect
   detection, never invariant-pass); probe and unknown outcomes
   retained.
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.32.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.8's Dispatcher
   durability bridge, R5.19's reservation/deadline surfaces, R5.23's
   projection assembly. A new shared/persisted decision belongs in
   the owning ADR admission, not an implementation-local substitute.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (new module, `pub mod ops`) — the
   §5.2/D3-F3 confined observer apparatus, read-only by definition
   (no write/dispatch semantics):
   - `TrialMarker` — unique trial/effect marker record
     (`trial_id`, `effect_id`, `ordinal`, payload digest); canonical
     JSON line encode/parse.
   - `MarkerSink` — durable append-only marker log on its own path
     (the external world the runtime cannot roll back): non-
     idempotent `append` (flush+sync), disk re-read `markers()`,
     `count_for`, `duplicates()`, content `digest()` via
     `idp::address`.
   - `Sentinel` — denied/read-only target: create with expected
     bytes (read-only mode), `intact()` re-reads + digest-compares;
     mutation reports `false`.
   - `OpsObserver` — independently surviving supervisor: its own
     append-only `observer.jsonl` outside the run Store (re-open
     retains records = survives subject death); `note(entry|bytes|
     termination)` durable rows + `snapshot(point, sink, sentinel)`
     at `before_launch`/`at_boundary`/`after_quiescence` recording
     sink count/digest + sentinel intact; `rows()` replays the file.
   - Verdict folds (pure, honest labels): `o1_outcome`,
     `o8_outcome`, `kp4_outcome` over explicit evidence structs +
     `TrialFailure` closed set {missing_observer, unreached_fault,
     sink_delta, sentinel_mutation, stale_fence,
     duplicate_restoration, missing_unknown, missing_probe_obligation,
     detector_miss, external_zero} and `probe_authorization` —
     `ExternalSinkZero` source or absent probe ⇒ refused, never
     retry/settle. `defect_detected` is a distinct label from `pass`.
2. `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_32.rs` — the fixture battery over the
   kill_point_battery scaffold pattern (real Store/WAL, real
   Monitor/Π allow rows, real Dispatcher): `MarkerExecutor` appends
   one marker per effect to `MarkerSink` + notes to `OpsObserver`;
   `DuplicateExecutor` appends twice despite an `Ok` terminal
   (the O8 defect); probe variants (applied / not_applied /
   undeterminable / unsupported).
3. Build memory: this ledger, dated coverage note for the ten
   contributing REQs (engineered D/E; O×3 real-trial predicates owed
   R5.44), `docs/build/pr/R5.32.md`, closeout. No ADR anticipated —
   no shared/persisted decision (apparatus is an internal instrument,
   not a public contract); revisit at Phase 4.

counted whole; the run ledger + build memory excluded per the

vs the contract's **≤900-line split trigger**: 1.73× — crossing stands
under every inclusive counting, so per the contract's cap discipline
this run stops here: checkpoint commit only — no PR, no
BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER advance, no ci-boundary.

**Seam analysis.** (a) **AMEND** is weak at this margin: 1.73× is not
the R5.31 noise-floor case. (b) A **SPLIT** has a defensible owner
seam — *R5.32a*: the complete `ops` module (durable apparatus + probe/
verdict vocabulary + folds, ~596) plus a surface-level unit battery
over the pure pieces (marker/sink/sentinel/observer/survival +
fold-level negatives, ~250) ≈ 850, self-contained and green alone;
*R5.32b*: the real-dispatch integration battery only (scaffold +
O1/O2/O8 cell drivers ≈ 700) — asserts the landed API across the real
Store/WAL/Π/Dispatcher seams. Each leg is independently verifiable;
32b consumes the 32a contract unchanged. (c) Trimming ~660 lines to
force the count under 900 is rejected (the R5.31 record's
trim-to-duck rationale): it removes the AC-2 negative matrix and the
evidence folds' contract, not fat. Proposed disposition: **SPLIT at
the apparatus/battery seam**, or AMEND if the ruling prefers the
single cohesive unit — the work is verified either way.
